points.description: Writes the resolution formula LSB = VFS/2^N (with VFS = 5 V and N = 12 substituted, e.g. 5/2^12 or 5/4096). Using 2^12 − 1 = 4095 is also accepted. Must be written explicitly; a bare value with no formula earns 0 here.

Correct LSB value of about 1.22 mV (1.2207 mV; 1.2210 mV from 4095 accepted), obtained from the written formula in P1. If the student used a wrong stated range (10 V or ±5 V), award this mark only if the arithmetic matches that range. A bare 1.22 mV with no formula shown earns 0.

Divides the LSB voltage by the sensitivity (10 mV/N) to get the smallest resolvable force change of about 0.122 N (0.1221 N). Multiplying by the sensitivity, or a wrong LSB from a wrong range, earns 0 here. If no formula was shown for the LSB, this mark is given only if the division itself is shown.

rubric.notes: Full marks: formula VFS/2^N written, LSB ≈ 1.22 mV, then divided by 10 mV/N to give ≈ 0.122 N. Using 4095 instead of 4096 is fully accepted. Multiplying by the sensitivity loses the final mark only. A wrong range loses the final mark, and the LSB marks are kept only if the arithmetic matches the stated range. A bare value with no formula earns no LSB marks.
rubric.answer_key: LSB = VFS/2^N = 5 V / 4096 = 1.2207 mV (≈1.22 mV). Smallest resolvable force change = LSB / sensitivity = 1.2207 mV / (10 mV/N) = 0.1221 N.
